events.title: PPL stock slips after an August 7 earnings miss
events.summary: PPL stock slipped after reporting Q2 EPS of $0.33, missing the $0.34 forecast, despite revenue reaching $2.11 billion and the company maintaining its fiscal 2026 EPS guidance. Analysts remain constructive with a $42 price target, and PPL declared a steady quarterly dividend of $0.285 a share, reinforcing its defensive utility profile. The stock's current price of $34.69 is below its 52-week high but well above its low, with a market value of $26.11 billion.

articles.headline: PPL stock slips after an August 7 earnings miss

events.title: US business activity surges to 52-month high: S&P Global
events.summary: U.S. business activity reached a 52-month high in August, primarily driven by a resurgence in the services sector, according to S&P Global. While manufacturing saw a slowdown due to supply delays, overall business expectations hit a nine-month high, supported by strong business investment and high equity prices. Despite this growth, consumer expectations for business conditions declined, and retail sales fell in July, suggesting a potential reduction in consumer spending in the latter half of 2026.

articles.headline: US business activity surges to 52-month high: S&P Global

events.title: Goldman Sachs Group Inc Stock (GS) Moved Up by 3.73% on Aug 21: Facts Behind the Movement
events.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc (GS) saw its stock rise by 3.73% on August 21, driven by recovering investment banking and capital markets momentum, alongside elevated Treasury yield volatility benefiting its market-making operations. The company's strong fee pipeline, major global advisory roles, and position as a premier global liquidity provider contributed to the positive movement. Despite some technical sell signals and valuation concerns, robust trading revenue expectations and a recovering advisory backlog continue to fuel investor interest.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs Group Inc Stock (GS) Moved Up by 3.73% on Aug 21: Facts Behind the Movement

events.title: Southern Copper Stock Stays Hot After Q2 Earnings Beat
events.summary: Southern Copper Corporation (SCCO) stock surged over 8% following a strong Q2 earnings beat, with EPS nearly doubling and revenue significantly increasing, driven by strong copper demand. Despite a downgrade from CICC due to valuation concerns, the stock demonstrated significant operating leverage against rising copper prices. Traders are closely watching SCCO, balancing its strong fundamentals and momentum with the cautious analyst rating.

articles.headline: Southern Copper Stock Stays Hot After Q2 Earnings Beat

events.title: PulteGroup stock holds firm after Q2 2026 results
events.summary: PulteGroup Inc. (PHM) stock is trading at $128.49 after reporting second-quarter 2026 revenue of $4 billion and earnings of $2.48 per share, beating consensus EPS estimates by 12 cents. While revenue was slightly below expectations, the beat on EPS indicates strong margins and cost control. The company's diversified homebuilding mix and services contribute to its resilient earnings despite uneven revenue growth.

articles.headline: PulteGroup stock holds firm after Q2 2026 results

events.title: EQT Corp. stock holds in the low $50s as Q2 2026 earnings miss consensus
events.summary: EQT Corp. (EQT) stock is trading in the low $50s after reporting Q2 2026 earnings and revenue that missed consensus estimates. The company's adjusted earnings per share declined by 13.3% year-over-year to $0.39, missing the $0.41 consensus, while revenue dropped 29.2% to $1.81 billion, falling short of the $1.84 billion estimate. This performance was attributed to lower realized natural gas prices despite an 11.7% increase in sales volumes, highlighting the company's sensitivity to commodity price fluctuations.

articles.headline: EQT Corp. stock holds in the low $50s as Q2 2026 earnings miss consensus

events.title: Ecolab stock holds firm after July 28 earnings beat
events.summary: Ecolab Inc. reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, beating consensus estimates with $2.09 adjusted EPS and $4.42 billion in revenue. The company also provided optimistic Q3 2026 guidance, reinforcing its stock's position in the upper range of its 52-week performance. Despite mixed institutional buying and insider selling, Ecolab's core business in water treatment and hygiene continues to drive its valuation, which analysts consider fair given its industrial large-cap status.

articles.headline: Ecolab stock holds firm after July 28 earnings beat

events.title: Ingersoll Rand stock holds in the high $70s as institutional buying supports the trend
events.summary: Ingersoll Rand Inc. (US45687V1061) stock is trading in the high $70s on the NYSE, supported by significant institutional buying, including a major European bank acquiring over 1.2 million shares. This institutional confidence, coupled with recent quarterly revenue and earnings growth, indicates a constructive outlook for the industrial products group. The company continues to deliver strong financial performance, maintain a healthy backlog, and emphasize balance sheet resilience, reinforcing investor expectations for continued compound growth.

events.title: Above the Noise: AI, earnings, and permabears
events.summary: This article discusses the current market environment, highlighting the strong demand for AI technology that already exceeds supply, contrasting it with past speculative booms. The author points to robust corporate earnings growth without significant hiring increases as potential evidence of AI-driven productivity gains. It also addresses "permabear" concerns about market tops, arguing that current conditions like resilient growth and available liquidity challenge such narratives, while acknowledging the value of bearish perspectives in challenging assumptions.

articles.headline: Above the Noise: AI, earnings, and permabears

events.title: Medifast director Parsa Kiai acquires $842,698 in company shares By Investing.com
events.summary: Medifast director Parsa Kiai indirectly acquired shares worth $842,698 on August 19 and 20, 2026, through investment entities he manages. Despite Medifast's impressive gross profit margins, it has not been profitable over the last twelve months, although it recently surpassed analyst expectations for Q2 2026 financial results.

events.title: CoStar Closes on $800 Million Zonda Acquisition
events.summary: CoStar Group has finalized its $800 million acquisition of Zonda, a leading provider of new home construction data, software, and residential real estate marketplaces. This strategic move expands CoStar's presence in the residential real estate sector, integrating Zonda's proprietary lot-level database and online marketplaces like NewHomeSource.com and Livabl. CoStar aims to leverage this acquisition to accelerate innovation and deliver more value to the homebuilding industry, combining Zonda's capabilities with its existing market intelligence and technology.

articles.headline: CoStar Closes on $800 Million Zonda Acquisition

events.title: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.18% on Aug 21: What Signal Does It Send?
events.summary: Newmont Corporation (NEM) stock increased by 3.18% on August 21, driven by strong spot gold prices, increased market demand, and favorable analyst commentary. The rally was fueled by lower long-term bond yields and a weaker U.S. Dollar Index, making gold more attractive, alongside positive company-specific fundamentals like strong operational margins and successful capital expansion projects. While technical indicators suggest strong momentum, potential risks include overbought conditions, insider share sales, and possible production guidance cuts.

articles.headline: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.18% on Aug 21: What Signal Does It Send?

events.title: Union Pacific Merger Deal Gets Rail Regulator Review Timeline
events.summary: The Surface Transportation Board has set an official timeline for its review of the proposed merger between Union Pacific Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp., aiming for a final decision by summer 2027. This deal would create the first coast-to-coast rail network in the US, though the timeline allows for extensions. Union Pacific CEO Jim Vena had initially hoped to finalize the merger much sooner.

articles.headline: Union Pacific Merger Deal Gets Rail Regulator Review Timeline

events.title: Diamondback Energy stock trades close to record high as big institutions add exposure

articles.headline: Diamondback Energy stock trades close to record high as big institutions add exposure

events.title: CoStar Group Completes $800M Zonda Acquisition, Expanding New Home Platform
events.summary: CoStar Group Inc. has finalized its $800 million acquisition of Zonda, a move that significantly expands its presence in the new home construction market. This acquisition integrates Zonda's data, software, and residential marketplaces, including its proprietary lot-level database, into CoStar's existing real estate information and technology portfolio. The deal is expected to enhance CoStar's residential segment's profitability and open new growth opportunities by cross-selling products and leveraging Zonda's established customer base.

articles.headline: CoStar closes $800M Zonda acquisition
